newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Amex Brazil's unit changes president.
newsitem.headline: Amex Brazil's unit changes president.

text.p: American Express Co. Brazilian affiliate has named Roberto Cavalcanti as its new president, replacing Raul Rosenthal, who has resigned, the firm said in a statement.
The statement said Cavalcanti, a Brazilian who was the former president of Amex's Argentine affiliate, will take office next month.
Cavalcanti arrives at a time the firm is setting up a new strategy to increase market share in Brazil, the world's seventh larget market for credit cards.
Under the new plan, Amex has set a partnership with bank Banco de Credito Nacional to issue Amex's credit cards.
